name: 60 Days of Us
source:
60 Days of Us is a visual novel set in the midst of a zombie outbreak. You play as Will, a former soldier who must protect his younger sister Evelyn while leading a group of survivors through the chaos. Every choice you make will shape their journey.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/Eizenhower]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《我们的60天》是一部以僵尸爆发为背景的视觉小说。你扮演威尔，一名前士兵，必须保护他的妹妹伊芙琳，同时带领一群幸存者度过混乱。你所做的每一个选择都将影响他们的旅程。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/Eizenhower]Patreon[/url]]
